## Checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the scope of the linked issue.
- [ ] Catalog content, analysis and presentation remain separated.
- [ ] Documentation is updated, and does not claim a capability that is still a proposal.
- [ ] New catalog content follows the structure of an existing algorithm, including tests in every language it implements.
- [ ] Accessibility was considered for any user-facing change.
